request: Goal: Run final-regression only when necessary while preserving regression confidence. Scope: clarify test-execute versus final-regression responsibilities; reuse fresh full-regression evidence from test-execute; add risk-based skip with audit artifacts; fail closed for runtime-sensitive, config-sensitive, external integration, or unknown changes; update report/status/schema/prompt handling and unit tests. Out of Scope: cross-flow last-known-green reuse beyond same-flow test-execute evidence. Description: Issue #391 enhances the flow so full project regression is not paid twice when equivalent or stronger evidence already exists, while skipped final-regression still writes a reviewable artifact explaining the proof and classification.

notes.text: draft-refine q1: approved same-flow test-execute full regression reuse when evidence is fresh
draft-refine q2: approved fail-closed risk-based skip only for clearly non-runtime changes
draft-refine q3: approved public final-regression skipped artifact with skipKind and evidence
draft-refine q4: approved scope limited to same-flow evidence reuse; cross-flow last-known-green out of scope
draft-refine q5: approved acceptance coverage for skip branches, run fallback, stale evidence, fail-closed unknowns, and downstream contract handling
